SuppressWelcomePage.title: Suppress Welcome Page
SuppressWelcomePage.description: Suppress the welcome and guide pages from opening automatically on first install.

AutoDim.title: AutoDim
AutoDim.description: Automatically dim the background when you click the play button and vice versa.

AutoStop.title: AutoStop
AutoStop.description: Stop playing the video automatically when I open a web page.

AutoHD.title: YouTube AutoHD
AutoHD.description: Automatically set YouTube videos to the configured HD quality.

AutoHDQuality.title: YouTube video quality
AutoHDQuality.description: The YouTube video quality to enforce. Valid values: 'highres', 'hd4320', 'hd2880', 'hd2160', 'hd1440', 'hd1080', 'hd720', 'large', 'medium', 'small', 'tiny', 'default'.

Block60FPS.title: Block 60FPS
Block60FPS.description: Block 60FPS video playback on YouTube to reduce bandwidth and CPU usage.

NightModeSwitch.title: Night Mode
NightModeSwitch.description: Show the night mode switch on the web page to allow users to switch the page to a dark mode theme.

MouseVolumeScroll.title: Mouse Volume Scroll
MouseVolumeScroll.description: Enable volume control via mouse scroll wheel on HTML5 videos.

VideoToolbar.title: Video Toolbar
VideoToolbar.description: Show the video toolbar with playback controls on HTML5 videos.

DefaultDimColor.title: Default Dimmed Layer Color
DefaultDimColor.description: The default color of the dimmed layer as a hex color (e.g., '#000000').

DefaultOpacity.title: Default Opacity
DefaultOpacity.description: The default dim opacity percentage from 0 to 100 (default: 80).

NightModeScope.title: Night Mode Scope
NightModeScope.description: Whether night mode applies to all websites or only the configured domain list. Valid values: 'all', 'domainlist'.

NightModeFilterType.title: Night Mode Filter Type
NightModeFilterType.description: Whether the night mode domain list acts as a whitelist (only listed domains get night mode) or a blacklist (all domains except listed get night mode). Valid values: 'whitelist', 'blacklist'.

NightModeDomainList.title: Night Mode Domain List
NightModeDomainList.description: A list of domains for night mode filtering. Each key is a domain URL and the value is true. Example: {"https://www.youtube.com": true, "https://www.nytimes.com": true}.

NightModeEngine.title: Night Mode Engine
NightModeEngine.description: The night mode engine type. 'standard' uses basic color inversion, 'personalized' uses advanced customization with individual color settings.

NightModeBackgroundColor.title: Night Mode Background Color
NightModeBackgroundColor.description: The background color for night mode as a hex color (e.g., '#1e1e1e').

NightModeTextColor.title: Night Mode Text Color
NightModeTextColor.description: The text color for night mode as a hex color (e.g., '#ffffff').

NightModeHyperlinkColor.title: Night Mode Hyperlink Color
NightModeHyperlinkColor.description: The hyperlink color for night mode as a hex color (e.g., '#ffffff').

NightModeButtonColor.title: Night Mode Button Color
NightModeButtonColor.description: The button color for night mode as a hex color (e.g., '#353535').

NightModeBorderColor.title: Night Mode Border Color
NightModeBorderColor.description: The border color for night mode as a hex color (e.g., '#545454').

EyeProtection.title: Eye Protection
EyeProtection.description: Enable the eye protection feature that automatically dims the screen for eye strain prevention. When false, the extension operates in regular video mode.

EyeProtectionScope.title: Eye Protection Scope
EyeProtectionScope.description: Whether eye protection applies to all websites or only the configured domain list. Valid values: 'all', 'domainlist'.

EyeProtectionFilterType.title: Eye Protection Filter Type
EyeProtectionFilterType.description: Whether the eye protection domain list acts as a whitelist (only listed domains get eye protection) or a blacklist (all domains except listed get eye protection). Valid values: 'whitelist', 'blacklist'.

EyeProtectionDomainList.title: Eye Protection Domain List
EyeProtectionDomainList.description: A list of domains for eye protection filtering. Each key is a domain URL and the value is true. Example: {"https://www.youtube.com": true, "https://vimeo.com": true}.
